semantics.reset: asynchronous active-high; selects A immediately and holds A while asserted
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified; verification applies after reset
semantics.output: Combinational Mealy output: in A z=x; in B z=~x. After reset settles z=x, including while reset is asserted. No registered output or additional latency.

numeric.behavior: copy bits through first 1 inclusive, then complement subsequent bits; FSM implements serial two's complement
numeric.arithmetic: Boolean operations only; no signed arithmetic, rounding, saturation or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent single Boolean seen_one flag, cleared by asynchronous reset and set on rising edge with x=1; expected z is x XOR seen_one
coverage: Input changes between clock edges to verify Mealy response
Reset assertion between edges from B, reset held over edges, release without state change
Exhaust all 256 eight-bit serial words; compare pre-edge output to modulo-256 negation bit and post-edge output to updated oracle
Check one-hot state after reset and each clock
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, explicit dev_tb top, -g2012; finite compile and simulation timeouts

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before reset and behavior of illegal one-hot encodings are unspecified; no tests demand either.
